fixture.api: local Firestore-compatible handler with in-memory synthetic fixture
fixture.notes: 20 synthetic small notes with five revisions each and one 128 KiB synthetic note
fixture.privacy: No real Notes, content, IDs, sessions, tokens, credentials or secrets.

method.main: origin/main frontend assets and current local handler; viewport prefetch disabled
method.candidate: final local PR #34 source with 80 ms prefetch scheduling grace, concurrency 1, same fixture/harness
method.clock: Wall action measures; browser requests/response bytes; in-handler server duration; dedicated click-to-text and two-rAF paint timestamps. A 20-sample p95 is the maximum order statistic and is noisy.
method.cancellations: AbortError is a deliberate canceled request and is counted separately; HTTP/request errors are separate. Main/candidate fixtures are not Vercel/Production.

measurements.interpretation: Navigation from reload through first list card; candidate includes allowed viewport prefetch.
Navigation with authenticated local acknowledged cache.
Scroll to last card and wait for its already-rendered preview to be in viewport. No note click in this measurement window.
Main and candidate prefetch-off are uncached reads; candidate full run may have prefetched a subset before click.
Main reads full 128 KiB body; candidate case is already cached and performs revision validation only, so these are not equivalent open states.
Acknowledged cache available after reload; action wall time includes automation/layout overhead.
Two keystrokes while note/revalidation traffic is delayed 120 ms.
Same three synthetic note targets prewarmed each sample. Prefetch is not active in the measured switch window; 40 candidate AbortError cancellations are expected stale work.

candidateOpenAfterSuccessfulPrefetch.note: The exact candidate prefetch-to-open scenario has no main equivalent because main has no prefetch. The bytes include list and prefetch warmup plus revision-only validation; click-to-paint excludes setup.

candidateClickDuringInFlightPrefetch.note: 20 controlled samples: hold the visible note prefetch request, click the same note, then release it. One in-flight content read is adopted; unrelated pending prefetch work is canceled.

speculativePrefetchUse.case: cold list, no note click in this case
speculativePrefetchUse.note: These prefetched bytes had no click within that measured interaction window; they may be used by a later user action. This is not a claim that they were never used during the whole browser session.

speculativePrefetchUse.case: warm list, no note click in this case

cachedListP95Ms.result: Not met in the matched full run: candidate cold and warm p95 both exceed 300 ms.

cachedOpenP95Ms.result: Broad wall action exceeds 100 ms; dedicated already-prefetched and adopted-inflight editor paint profiles are below 100 ms in this fixture. This does not establish physical-device performance.

typingP95Ms.result: Not met by the full candidate run; large-tail variance is material.

previewFirestoreCost: Preview is extended from 100 to 200 characters in the existing authorized metadata/list query. There is no separate per-note preview request and no additional Firestore document read; bytes stored/transferred and future metadata write sizes increase. Existing stored 100-character previews are not bulk migrated and grow on the next note save.

cloudQualification.evidence: Canonical Vercel project has no isolated Preview test environment; retired notes-firestore-exact-082 project is absent; current project env inventory is Production-only. No candidate note/history read was performed via Vercel OIDC.
cloudQualification.release: Keep PR draft and Production aliases unchanged. Do not substitute NAS/fixture evidence.

key1.result: Recommended IntersectionObserver prefetch bounded to visible/nearby rows; click adopts same in-flight content read; keep foreground operations outside background serialized work. Confirmed old fixed first-eight strategy and 100-character list summaries from supplied code.
key1.accepted: Viewport observation, in-flight adoption and foreground/background isolation were independently verified and implemented.

key2.result: Recommended scroll-direction prioritization and stale/scope guards. Claimed RequestLane was concurrency one for prefetch.
key2.accepted: Scroll direction and stale/scope protections checked in source and adopted.
key2.rejected: The RequestLane characterization was imprecise: prefetch already ran sequentially but occupied the API lane. Measurements showed foreground contention; candidate background reads bypass that lane and can be canceled/adopted.

key3.role: independent cache isolation and ACK analysis
key3.result: Highlighted scope isolation, cache freshness and ACK integrity; suggested extra IME/selection guard. Also cited sub-180 ms cached-open as supporting evidence.
key3.accepted: Cache-only-server-ACK, revision scope and dirty-editor protection were verified; existing IME guard retained.
key3.rejected: Sub-180 ms did not measure the comparable navigation-to-editor path and was excluded from performance claims.

key4.role: final code, race, cache isolation and data-loss review
key4.result: No code-level release blocker found. Confirmed 200-character metadata preview, ACK/scoped cache, logout purge, viewport observer, dirty/IME guards and CAS preservation.
key4.accepted: Final browser/source evidence agrees; keep explicit active note-ID check and cancellation catch.
key4.clarified: Gemini described the 40/session budget as 40 concurrent prefetches; source actually enforces concurrency 1 through prefetchRunning. Forty is the maximum number of starts, not simultaneous requests.

key5.role: final requirements, tests and benchmark review
key5.result: Confirmed matched synthetic fixture coverage, and identified non-equivalent main/candidate large-note state; final report labels it. Confirmed warm/cold list, broad cached-open and typing p95 targets are not met. Recommended draft/no promotion pending OIDC and latency-tail improvements.
key5.accepted: AbortError cancellation is separated from request failures; preserve the explicit limits and no-production claim.
key5.rejected: Its initial claim that the prefetch promise itself lacked a rejection sink was inaccurate; the openNote caller-await path needed and received a catch. Quota/corruption coverage already exists.
key5.remaining: Offline-to-online prefetch queue resume has no dedicated integration test; report as a remaining test gap, not as evidence of a runtime fault.

releaseTests.browser: 33/33 passed on Chromium headless/NAS synthetic fixture after final viewport scheduler change
releaseTests.retryLoad: passed simulated fake-WebDAV virtual-time harness; not live service capacity
releaseTests.focused: bounded viewport/adopted read, cached revalidation/open/save, cache-first dirty editor, stale response, quota/corruption, logout/offline, 20-sample prefetch states
releaseTests.cloud: Vercel OIDC isolated-vault qualification not run; release-blocking

conclusion: The candidate improves the cached paint path in the dedicated synthetic prefetch cases and reduces old foreground-lane waiting, but the matched full run is noisy: warm-list p95 does not improve, scroll is close/slightly slower, typing has a large p95 tail, and broad cached-open action exceeds 100 ms. No stable overall Production speedup or 8/10 Google Keep experience is established.
